title: Health & pharmacy
body:
Police: 110. Ambulance/fire: 119. Both connect callers to an interpreter for English (and other languages) — speak slowly and stay on the line rather than hanging up if the first responder doesn't have English.

Matsue has full-service pharmacies and hospitals near the station. Oda City has a smaller hospital and a handful of pharmacies in the town center; the Omori heritage district itself has none — anyone needing regular medication should carry it, not plan to refill it there.

The Iwami Ginzan mine trail and the Ginzan Cart route involve uneven ground, some stairs, and long stretches without shade or seating — pace the two low-mobility travelers' day around it rather than the group average (see Days).
